interaction_paired._scheme: One bootstrap index vector per resample, applied to both arms: repeat r pins seed r in both, so the arms are paired by seed. The `interaction` section above uses independent index streams per arm, which is what the published intervals were computed with and what this file therefore keeps reproducing. Where the arms correlate, the unpaired interval is the wider one and the paired one is correct.

coverage.note: Monte-Carlo coverage of the percentile bootstrap against a known Binomial truth at this grid's cell shape. Measured well below nominal is the known small-n deficiency of the percentile method, not an implementation fault -- but an interval reported as 95% that covers less than that is a reader-facing error either way.

multiplicity.note: No multiplicity correction is applied to the reported intervals; these are the numbers needed to read them. With this many intervals, one excluding zero is the expected outcome under a global null, not a finding.
